reason: The README describes a model control plane that inspects registered provider routes, updates the default model for new sessions, and probes external provider /models endpoints; external-services is the best primary category.

summaries.zh: 用于检查已注册的模型提供商路由、为新会话设置默认模型，并探测兼容 OpenAI 的模型接口可达性。
summaries.en: A model control plane for inspecting registered provider routes, setting the default model for new sessions, and probing OpenAI-compatible model endpoints.

capabilities: Inspects registered provider routes and model metadata
Validates and saves the default provider/model for new sessions
Sends GET requests to configured OpenAI-compatible /models endpoints
Reports endpoint reachability, HTTP status, latency, model count, and credential configuration state
